fusions.name: Pull Down the Thatch
fusions.desc: A hauling cut that deals 13 fire damage, sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Raked Coals
fusions.desc: Rakes live coals through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 fire damage to everything caught in it, with a 35% chance per hit to leave it [Burning] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Ember Furrow
fusions.desc: Drags a line of live coals 5 tiles long across the ground for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hot Iron Answer
fusions.desc: When a non-fire blow hurts you, a red-hot barb flies to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 5 damage and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
